parameters.name: DIJobId
parameters.description: **[Deprecated]** This parameter is deprecated. Use the Id parameter instead.

parameters.name: NodeType
parameters.description:
The node type. This parameter is applicable only to tasks that run on resource group 2.0. Valid values:

* **MASTER**: retrieves the JobManager logs.
* **WORKER**: retrieves the TaskManager logs.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for paging. The value must be a positive integer greater than or equal to 1.
